Voynich MS - Quire 4

General

For an explanation of the material found on this page, see here.

Description

Quire 4 is a standard quire containing folios 25 through 32. The gathering mark is on f32v.

All pages in this quire have herbal illustrations, but there is a mixture of pages with Currier languages A and B.

Schematic folio layout:

Folio 25

Normal folio. The folio nr. is on f25r.

f25r

General description

This is a herbal page. For general information about herbal pages see here.
It has the folio nr (25) in the upper right corner.

Illustration(s)

A simple plant, with small brown 'beans' attached to the stem in a few places.

Herbal drawing characterisation (Gheuens/Rapaport):
α: veined leaves

Text

This page has 7 text items (loci), as follows:
6 lines of standard text in paragraphs;
1 right-justified word ('title') at the last line of the text.

The text is in a single paragraph, with an additional stand-alone word right-justified on the last line of the text.

Currier language: A
RZ language: A (page) / A (folio) / A (bifolio)
LFD hand: 1

Browse interlinear transliteration of f25r

Tentative identifications

ELV: parietaria, urtica? ThP: menta hortensis, herzkraut (O'Neill), marrube, mercurialis, mentha arvensis, urtica, mentastrum (O'Neill), mentha piperatica.

General description

This is a herbal page. For general information about herbal pages see here.
It has the folio nr (32) in the upper right corner.

Illustration(s)

Plant drawing. Many small green leaves. Five flowers in white and blue, with small yellow crown.

Herbal drawing characterisation (Gheuens/Rapaport):
α: flower(s) seen from the side
α: two distinct leaf shapes

Text

This page has 19 text items (loci), as follows:
19 lines of standard text in paragraphs.

There are 19 lines of text in two paragraphs. The second paragraph has very short lines ending at the plant.

There are two characters written inside the bottom right flower, above each other. The top one looks like a 'p' and the bottom one could be an 'r' or a 'v'. It is unclear if the small stroke right of the 'p' is part of another character, or part of the drawing.

Currier language: A
RZ language: A (page) / A (folio) / A (bifolio)
LFD hand: 1

Browse interlinear transliteration of f32r

Tentative identifications

ELV: mentha, some kind of mint. ThP: mentastrum (O'Neill), rosenmüntz, brunella vulgaris.

Other information

The characters in the bottom right flower are reminiscent of colour annotations, see also f29r above.
